# A career that makes a difference

Perceptyx is a place for those who challenge the limits.

[View Job Openings](https://jobs.gem.com/perceptyx)

## Join our team!

![Lisa Sterling](https://go.perceptyx.com/hs-fs/hubfs/leaders/lisa-sterling.jpg?width=195&height=195&name=lisa-sterling.jpg)

> “At Perceptyx, we operate like a championship team. United by purpose, driven by performance, and fueled by the belief that how we play the game matters as much as winning it. As Pyxers, we each have a role to play, and we own it. We show up with accountability, resilience, and a relentless drive to deliver impacts.
>
> We train with intention, adapt fast, and execute with excellence. Our customers are our MVPs, and we champion them by anticipating their needs, delivering real outcomes, and exceeding expectations at every turn.
>
> We’re not just here to maintain the status quo. We’re here to lead. We innovate with purpose, challenging each other to think bigger, move faster, and raise the bar together. #OneTeamOneFuture
>
> Above all, we know that great teams aren’t just built on talent. They’re built on trust, inclusion, and shared wins. We celebrate each other, recognizing the unique strengths and contributions that make this team unstoppable.
>
> If you’re ready to play at the highest level and be part of something extraordinary — join the team. Let’s go win, together.”

## Awesome   Perks & Benefits   **That Stand Out**

### Perks for **New Parents**

In addition to a generous and flexible parental leave program, we offer additional perks such as the Milk Stork program to support our parents.

Learn More about Perks for **New Parents**

### **Flexible** Work-Day

We believe work is what you do not where or when you do it. We provide flexibility to our employees so they can work in a way that meets our business needs and their way of life.

Learn More about **Flexible** Work-Day

### Support for **Traveling Employees**

As a global organization, we support our employees who travel outside their local country.

Learn More about Support for **Traveling Employees**

### **Flexible** Time Away

We don’t focus on counting days but rather on making the days count. We want you to enjoy your time off.

Learn More about **Flexible** Time Away

### Diverse Observed **Paid Holidays**

We ensure that our holiday programs reflect the richness of our employees’ backgrounds and experiences.

Learn More about Diverse Observed **Paid Holidays**

### **Bereavement Leave** Program

We deeply value the healing process and acknowledge the importance of providing employees with the necessary time off to properly mourn and grieve.

Learn More about **Bereavement Leave** Program

### Perks for **New Parents**

Moms and dads will receive 14 weeks of paid time off to bond and care for your new child. We also support our new moms returning to work who encounter the challenges of managing career responsibilities and feeding their babies, particularly when traveling for work. With Milk Stork, you can get breast milk home from anywhere in the world.

### **Flexible** Work-Day

We don’t focus on watching when our employees clock-in and clock-out. All People Leaders work with individual employees to find common ground on your work day schedule, then they trust you to get the job done! We also provide our employees with the necessary tools to get the job done from home.

### Support for **Traveling Employees**

We ensure that our employees traveling outside their home country have automatic access to medical insurance, covering accidental injuries and illness for business purposes.

### **Flexible** Time Away

We want you to enjoy your time off. As hard as we work, we also know it’s essential to take time away to rest and recharge. Perceptyx supports flexible time away.

### Diverse Observed **Paid Holidays**

Perceptyx is based in the USA, but our employees are everywhere! We want to ensure our global employees get to observe the holidays that matter in their part of the world, so depending on where you live, Perceptyx will take your countries significant holidays into account.

### **Bereavement Leave** Program

There is no time more important to care for our employees than when they experience a loss. The Perceptyx Bereavement Leave Program provides paid time off to eligible employees for time away related to the death of an immediate family member, a close relative, or a close friend. Our program includes the loss of pregnancy due to miscarriage or stillbirth. Our program also extends to the death of a beloved family pet.

## Additional Perks

### Comprehensive Health Benefits

A health plan that includes medical, dental. vision and more to ensure you and your family a healthier, happier life.

### A Partner in Planning for Your Future

We support you as you grow in life. Perceptyx partners with employees to support their individual goals in life - from retirement to building a family.

### Self-Development Opportunities

Access to over 65,000 learning resources in our online learning program, and other opportunities for skill and capability development to enable you to achieve your career goals.

### Recognition and Rewards

We recognize and celebrate achievements because together, we inspire, and we succeed! Perceptyx offers a space where every employee’s voice is heard and valued. The Perceptyx Pioneer Awards recognize those true unsung heroes who embody our core values every day and deserve long-standing appreciation for their contributions.

### Fitness Reimbursement Program

We provide all regular full-time employees with an annual allowance to spend on a variety of fitness-related expenses.

### Compassion Care Program

To better enable our people to care for their family members, all full-time employees who have completed at least one year of service can request up to six (6) weeks of paid time off to care for their eligible family member over a rolling 12-month period.

### The Gift of Time to Give Back

The causes important to you are important to us which is why we give every employee two paid days per year to volunteer their time where and when it matters most.

### Celebrate You Program

We believe our employees should have the opportunity to celebrate all cultures and religions that are meaningful to them. In addition to the company holidays, full-time and part-time employees will receive up to two additional ‘Celebrate You’ days off.
